profile.summary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products in India and internationally. It operates through Sugar, Power, and Distillery segments. The company produces white sugar products; and cogenerates power from bagasse. It also engages in production of extra neutral alcohol, ethanol, and rectified spirit distillery products.
